culprit_citations.quoted_text: Total investments at fair value (amortized cost of $ 36,024,256 and $ 35,983,158, respectively) | 35,500,450 | 35,918,948

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation is decisive. The March 31, 2026 balance sheet and the filing's Schedule of Investments independently report current-period amortized cost of $36,024.256 million, while the extracted 876-position cost sum is $38,654.956 million. The $2,630.700 million overstatement equals 7.303% of the filing anchor, exactly reproducing the flag. A targeted residual search did not identify a single disclosed subtotal equal to the residual, so the aggregate extraction defect is real but not localized to a specific source row.
